# Agentic NFT Launchpad

> Public ERC-721 mint collection directory for humans and autonomous agents on BNB Smart Chain (chain ID 56).

## Canonical resources
- Website: https://agentic-nft-registry.pages.dev/
- Agent discovery: https://agentic-nft-registry.pages.dev/agent-discovery.json
- Agent Card: https://agentic-nft-registry.pages.dev/.well-known/agent-card.json
- Agent instructions: https://agentic-nft-registry.pages.dev/AGENTS.md
- Collections registry: https://agentic-nft-registry.pages.dev/registry/collections.json
- Read-only collections API: https://agentic-nft-registry.pages.dev/api/agent/collections
- Source: https://github.com/Oceebigman/agentic-nft-registry

## Key facts
- Network: BNB Smart Chain Mainnet, chain ID 56.
- Wallet connection is not required to browse.
- Binance Agent ID is not required globally. HARTB, BLUM and PLUTO require it for both free and paid mints, enforced by their contracts.
- Gated quotas are per Agent ID; legacy collections use per-wallet quotas.
- Free mint uses mintFree(uint256); paid mint uses mint(uint256) and exact BNB value.
- Always inspect live contract state and obtain explicit user authorization before a transaction.

See /AGENTS.md for the full agent workflow.
